::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Established 2023, with offices in Bengaluru (HSR Layout) and Hyderabad (IIIT-H CIE). Offers silicon IP and custom ASIC development along with embedded and silicon services.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Silicon IP blocks and turnkey ASIC/FPGA design.
